hypothesis: At small search budgets, sequential halving and completed-Q policy targets produce stronger policy iteration than PUCT visitation targets.
intervention: Full native Gumbel AlphaZero versus PUCT with FPU0.2, Dirichlet0.25 alpha0.15 and temperature1 for30 moves. Both use the same full CNN initialization, ownership1.5/score1 losses, score utility factor0, optimizer and self-play/replay budgets. Gumbel uses at most16 considered actions, value scale0.1, offset50, Q-range scaling, training perturbation1 and deterministic evaluation.

primary_metric.name: paired candidate score against the fresh matched PUCT checkpoint
primary_metric.referee: Pinned official KataGo verifies every played board and complete score; it chooses no moves.
primary_metric.qualification: Run the complete fixed panel; move caps have no assigned outcome and invalidate the paired qualification. Stop on actual board/rule/score inconsistencies. This larger cap is declared for a new study, not a reinterpretation of the earlier incomplete FPU panel.

absolute_metric.scope: Continue the pinned absolute anchor; report zero-win floors and incomplete games without ranking them.

secondary_metrics: actual active neural evaluations and neural slots
self-play completed games, truncations and eligible rows
reserved attempt windows and CPU/wall time, with overlap noted
control at8192 compared with the earlier score-factor-zero run to detect execution regressions
promotion: Exploratory promising flag only if the primary panel is complete, paired score>=0.65 and conservative paired95 lower bound>0.5, with all board/score checks passed. No production promotion or algorithmic sample-efficiency claim from one seed. Finalists need independent seeds, larger absolute anchors and board-size transfer.
limitations: Both search systems are under-tuned at16 simulations; this is not full KataGo or original-scale AlphaZero reproduction.
The longer fixed horizon calibrates a more informative learning stage after several shorter zero-win screens.
Architecture and objectives are fixed; search allocation, played-action rule, root perturbation and policy target are an algorithm bundle.
No Elo claim from the small deterministic opening panel.
Compression affects storage and wall time but not scientific arrays; its writer was checked on a real9x9 checkpoint.
Unknown allocation duration and durable bucket still limit sustained production planning; this is bounded research.
lineage: Both arms from scratch. No KataGo labels or weights enter training.
